parts:
Hello Jürgen,
I get the error "Not all values of stationCol in recordTable are matched by values of stationCol in CTtable"
Could it be that this error occurs when there are camera stations missing in the recordTable, but are listed in CTtable?
For Example: I have a recordTable only for wild boar (I had to split recordtables to get different minDeltaTimes for different species). At several stations there are no detection of wild boar - so no record of wild boars in the recordTable for these stations...

Thanks for your help,
Tobias

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] surveyReport Error: Not all values of stationCol in recordTable are matched by values of stationCol in CTtable
parts:
Hi Tobias,

the error means that there are values in the station column of your record table which are not found in the CT table. Basically the records cannot be assigned to the stations.

This is different from "camera stations missing in the recordTable, but are listed in CTtable" - that situation is very common and does not cause an error.

Download the Github version. I just added a small change that returns the offending station names. For example (adapted from the example in ?surveyReport):

data(camtraps)
data(recordTableSample)

# since version 2.1, camera operation matrix is required as input

camop_no_problem <- cameraOperation(CTtable      = camtraps,
                                    stationCol   = "Station",
                                    setupCol     = "Setup_date",
                                    retrievalCol = "Retrieval_date",
                                    writecsv     = FALSE,
                                    hasProblems  = FALSE,
                                    dateFormat   = "dmy"
)


recordTableSample$Station[1] <- "XX"
recordTableSample$Station[20] <- "YY"

reportTest <- surveyReport (recordTable          = recordTableSample,
                            CTtable              = camtraps,
                            camOp                = camop_no_problem,
                            speciesCol           = "Species",
                            stationCol           = "Station",
                            setupCol             = "Setup_date",
                            retrievalCol         = "Retrieval_date",
                            CTDateFormat         = "dmy",
                            recordDateTimeCol    = "DateTimeOriginal",
                            recordDateTimeFormat = "ymd HMS")

Error in surveyReport(recordTable = recordTableSample, CTtable = camtraps,  :
  Not all values of stationCol in recordTable are matched by values of stationCol in CTtable:
 XX, YY

Cheers,
Jürgen


It might be a typo or something.
